# Document intelligence benchmark fixtures

These fixtures are synthetic and contain no private vault material. The
manifest is intentionally small enough to run in CI while covering structural
signals that are easy to regress:

- headings, paragraphs, lists, fenced code, equations and figures;
- HTML reading order;
- a spreadsheet workbook generated from a JSON fixture;
- DOCX and PPTX files generated from JSON fixtures;
- a diagram PNG generated from JSON;
- digital, scientific/formula and scanned PDF slices generated by the harness.

The benchmark records one result per adapter and fixture. Providers that are
not installed or configured are reported as `SKIPPED` with the exact reason;
they are never represented as successful deterministic extraction. The
harness does not select a production default. A default requires an explicit
benchmark review and an `AKP_DOCUMENT_INTELLIGENCE_SELECTION` configuration.
